items.name: Everlast Classic Boxing Gloves

A full wrist-wrap hook-and-loop enclosure system provides a secure and highly customizable fit, ideal for boxing training.

items.name: Venum Giant 3.0 Boxing Gloves

items.description_en: The Venum Giant 3.0 Boxing Gloves provide punching power, protection and comfort with an anatomical shape that hugs the fists. Made of 100% Nappa leather with triple density foam for enhanced shock absorption, Velcro closure system, long cuffs for wrist protection and a full attached thumb.

items.name: Century Youth Brave Open Palm Gloves

items.description_en: The Century Youth Brave Open Palm Vinyl MMA Gloves feature a lightweight vinyl construction with foam padding for protection and hook-and-loop closures with adjustable elastic straps for a secure fit, allowing easy transition between partner and bag training.

items.name: adidas Youth Hybrid 25 Boxing Gloves

items.description_en: Youth boxing gloves ideal for beginners and light training. Durable PU exterior, breathable mesh interior, molded foam for protection, and secure Velcro closure for a snug fit.
